description: Run Playwright Test in the project and return per-test results. Failures include the error, its location and, when the cause was a locator, the locator Playwright was waiting for (pass it to heal_locator).

project.description: Only this Playwright project from playwright.config, e.g. "Mobile Safari"; omit to run all projects

spec.description: Spec file relative to tests/; omit to run everything
